sample_rule: first N records of pinned BFCL-v3 simple file, no outcome filtering
hf_adapter_change: Official v0.2.0 HF initialization; subsequent batch-size-one transitions use Python int token ID, CPU masks and MPS scores. Author matcher and mask kernels unchanged; current TVM FFI rejects torch scalar IDs.
timing_scope: includes CPU mask and MPS transfers; not serving throughput

metric_definitions.argument_exact: Strict complete JSON-schema-compliant tool call with all acceptable reference argument values; invalid format counts as failure
metric_definitions.content_argument_exact: Supplementary semantic diagnostic; permits stripping only a single whole-output Markdown JSON fence. This is not strict format compliance or an official BFCL score
metric_definitions.schema_valid: Strict original output is JSON and passes independent JSON Schema; completion reported separately
